native_adapters.status: Event cryptography links secp256k1-sys0.14.1; PostgreSQL verify-full preparation links ring/rustls but has no qualified network or engine run; no product storage binding yet
native_adapters.release_gates: P01-T01 and P02 actual bindings, offline assets, engine failures and native target qualification

crypto.build: Vendored C library through locked cc1.4.6; native C compiler required
crypto.license: CC0-1.0 wrapper and MIT vendored libsecp256k1; notices retained in dependency sources
crypto.features: std/alloc; no rand, recovery or fuzz crypto selected; clean builder strips ambient rustflags

tls.features: Explicit ring provider; rustls std/ring/tls12; no native-certs, webpki-roots or dangerous verifier
tls.qualified_scope: Offline parsing and connection-setting preparation only; actual TLS/PostgreSQL network behavior remains NOT_RUN
